title: Best friend pairs by type
caption:
Every best friend duo is two types who just make sense together.

The one who starts a debate at 1 am and the one who turns it into a deep talk. The one who packs the snacks and the one who makes the trip legendary. The one who fixes the bike and the one who breaks it, creatively.

Tag your best friend and tell us which pair you are.
